title: Site tree: new website preview
desc: Admin-only list of every page in the new website.
quick: Every page of the new website in order (67 pages), with its Google title and description, and the 93 facts the clinic still needs to confirm.
body:
How to review

  1. Structure: is any page missing, or in the wrong place?
  2. Content: open each page. Orange "to confirm" tags mark facts the clinic must check.
  3. Changes: send them to Danny on WhatsApp with the page name.
  4. Approve: once approved, the new design is switched on for visitors.

67 pages in the new site · 93 details to confirm · 12 old pages folded into stronger ones. Only logged-in admins can see this page and the new design.
